content:
In Physlib the names for the basic operations on tensors are awful (which is my fault) e.g.

  • Tensor.permT corresponds to permuting the indices of a tensor.
  • Tensor.evalT corresponds to evaluating the index of a tensor.
  • Tensor.contrT corresponds to contracting the indices of a tensor

  • etc

  • Pure.permP corresponds to permuting the indices of a pure tensor.

  • etc.

The original reason for permT and permP is often both namespaces Tensor and Pure are open so having different names helped.

Does anyone have better name suggestions for these?
